touchpoints.name: Evento métrica
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE httpResponseCode LIKE '5%%' FACET appName SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Consulta alerta consulta motor usuario
touchpoints.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Span FACET name SINCE 1 hour ago

touchpoints.name: Alerta cloud servicio vista alerta
touchpoints.query: SELECT count(*) FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE httpResponseCode LIKE '5%%' FACET name SINCE 24 hours ago

touchpoints.name: Entidad panel registro motor columna
touchpoints.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction FACET name SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Servicio tiempo motor sistema
touchpoints.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Span WHERE error IS true SINCE 1 hour ago

touchpoints.name: Dato tiempo red motor aplicación
touchpoints.query: SELECT sum(errorCount) FROM PageView WHERE appName LIKE 'web-%' FACET appName SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Cloud columna
touchpoints.query: SELECT sum(errorCount) FROM PageView WHERE name LIKE 'WebTransaction/%' SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Aplicación aplicación consulta
touchpoints.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Span FACET appName SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Servicio sistema usuario respuesta
touchpoints.query: SELECT count(*) FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE error IS true SINCE 1 hour ago
